hero.name: Tom Mosher
hero.subtitle: Software Engineer, Researcher, Educator, Non-profit Leader

workHistory.description: I get to push the limits of embedded systems by exploring new transport protocols, testing energy optimization techniques, and building on-board sensor fusion AI models.
I wrote core algorithms for a drone navigation company and learned a lot of nitty-gritty Go, gRPCs, and TensorFlow.
I again worked with incredible students and teachers in beautiful, rural Japan, learned the language, and rediscovered the great outdoors.
Under incredible tutelage of both Economists and Engineers I contributed to large, global studies on the questions of governance and education.

Here I fell into coding through critical inquiry of how global economic and social systems work. I discovered that if I can speak the language of computers and math at the same time, I can better dissect and contribute to claims of the empirical.
I was granted the incredible gift each day of being reminded how talented each student is, anywhere in the world.
I lived in two smaller cities and gained an incredible appreciation for Spanish and European cultures, and gained a critical view of my own native language while learning another.
I majored Religious Studies: having very long, socratic conversations with complex bodies of text prepared me well for writing great code.
